description: Rebuild Contacts.html and Resources.html with polished, professional CSS matching the app's design language. Both pages currently have zero CSS and no nav bar. This feature is independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 — it only touches Contacts.html, Resources.html, and two new CSS files.
steps: Create contacts.css at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/static/css/contacts.css. Design tokens: primary #0D80F2, bg #F0F2F5, text #121417, muted #61758A, border #E6E8EB, border-radius 8px, font Inter. Include: * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; } body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background: #F0F2F5; } header styles matching application.css (flex row, border-bottom, 12px 40px padding). .contacts-main { max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 40px 20px; } .contacts-heading { font-size 28px, font-weight 700, color #121417, margin-bottom 24px }. .contact-card { background #fff, border 1px solid #E6E8EB, border-radius 8px, padding 32px, display flex, gap 24px, align-items flex-start }. .contact-avatar { width 80px, height 80px, border-radius 50%, object-fit cover }. .contact-info { flex 1 }. .contact-name { font-size 22px, font-weight 700, color #121417 }. .contact-title { font-size 14px, color #61758A, margin-bottom 16px }. .contact-row { display flex, align-items center, gap 8px, margin-bottom 12px, font-size 14px, color #121417 }. .contact-row a { color #0D80F2, text-decoration none }. .contact-row a:hover { text-decoration underline }. dark mode: body.dark-mode { background #1a1a2e; color #e0e0e0; } body.dark-mode header { background #16213e; border-color #2a2a4e; } body.dark-mode .contact-card { background #16213e; border-color #2a2a4e; } body.dark-mode .contact-name, body.dark-mode .contact-row { color #e0e0e0; }

Rewrite Contacts.html at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/templates/Contacts.html. Full Thymeleaf template: <!DOCTYPE html><html lang='en' xmlns:th='http://www.thymeleaf.org'><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0'><title>Contact — JobTracker</title><link rel='stylesheet' th:href='@{/css/contacts.css}'><script th:src='@{/js/darkmode.js}'></script></head><body>. Header with logo (img at /images/886e770a-b523-4bc5-b893-a6c2272e507c.png), title JobTracker, nav links: Dashboard (th:href='@{/}'), Applications (th:href='@{/Applications}'), Settings (th:href='@{/Settings}'), Contacts (active, th:href='@{/Contacts}'). Main section with class='contacts-main': h1 'Contact', contact card with avatar image (/images/Depth 4, Frame 1.png), name 'Peter Bekana', title 'Software Developer', contact rows for Email (bpeter@gmail.com), Phone (+1 555 123 4567), LinkedIn (https://linkedin.com/in/peterbekana with target='_blank'), GitHub (https://github.com/peterbekana with target='_blank'). Include <script th:src='@{/js/notifications.js}'></script> before </body> (safe forward reference).

Create resources.css at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/static/css/resources.css. Same design tokens. Include: header styles same as contacts.css. .resources-main { max-width 960px, margin 0 auto, padding 40px 20px }. .resources-heading { font-size 28px, font-weight 700, color #121417, margin-bottom 8px }. .resources-subheading { font-size 16px, color #61758A, margin-bottom 32px }. .resources-grid { display grid, grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)), gap 20px }. .resource-card { background #fff, border 1px solid #E6E8EB, border-radius 8px, padding 24px, display flex, flex-direction column, gap 12px, transition box-shadow 0.2s }. .resource-card:hover { box-shadow 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) }. .resource-card-icon { width 48px, height 48px, border-radius 8px, background #F0F2F5, display flex, align-items center, justify-content center, font-size 24px }. .resource-card-title { font-size 18px, font-weight 700, color #121417 }. .resource-card-desc { font-size 14px, color #61758A, flex 1 }. .resource-card-link { display inline-block, padding 8px 16px, background #0D80F2, color #fff, border-radius 8px, text-decoration none, font-size 14px, font-weight 600, text-align center, align-self flex-start }. .resource-card-link:hover { background #0a6fd4 }. dark mode: body.dark-mode { background #1a1a2e; color #e0e0e0; } body.dark-mode header { background #16213e; border-color #2a2a4e; } body.dark-mode .resource-card { background #16213e; border-color #2a2a4e; } body.dark-mode .resource-card-title { color #e0e0e0; }

Rewrite Resources.html at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/templates/Resources.html. Full Thymeleaf template with same header/nav pattern as Contacts.html. Main section class='resources-main': h1 'Resources', subheading 'Useful links and tools for your job search'. Three resource cards in a .resources-grid div: (1) icon emoji 💼, title 'LinkedIn', description 'Connect with professionals and explore job opportunities on LinkedIn.', link to https://linkedin.com/in/peterbekana target='_blank' text 'Visit LinkedIn'. (2) icon 🐙, title 'GitHub', description 'Browse open-source projects and explore my code repositories on GitHub.', link to https://github.com/peterbekana target='_blank' text 'Visit GitHub'. (3) icon ✍️, title 'Medium Blog', description 'Read articles on software engineering, career tips, and technology trends.', link to https://medium.com/@peterbekana target='_blank' text 'Read Blog'. Include darkmode.js in head and notifications.js before </body>.
Run ./mvnw compile -q from /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main and confirm exit code 0.

Resources.html has a proper header with nav links, three styled resource cards in a grid, and links the resources.css stylesheet
